selection_rule: Per capability, lowest leave-one-trajectory-out (LOCO) MAE, equal weight per trajectory and per checkpoint within trajectory. All 12 candidates within 0.02 nats (inclusive) of the minimum tie: choose fewer fitted parameters, then lower MAE, then declared candidate order. F2 counts four coefficients plus one fitted discrete T_star. Refit coefficients, descriptor references, column scaling and F2 T_star inside each training fold; T_star minimizes training SSE per capability on V56's fixed five-value grid.
baseline_rule: Per student and capability, lowest development LOCO MAE among constant, intercept+T-only, intercept+E-only, and same-input surfaces with L0/logN. Exact ties: fewer parameters, then declared baseline order. Frozen before confirmation; no baseline selection or refitting on confirmation errors.
reference_rule: T_ref=35000; D_ref=median training-point D_U; N_ref=geometric mean of unique training-student total meta-device parameter counts (V50 convention, not training-manifest or nominal sizes). L0 and logN use population mean/std with equal weight per unique training student. Recompute within each fold.

confirmation_register.unused_U_assertion: U=200 absent from every pre-existing registered pool section
confirmation_register.sampling_rule: V12 load_sft_records: random.Random(f'{data_seed}-{domain}').sample(eligible JSONL rows, U); full recipe; drop empty completions; V12 max_len=1024 tokenization
confirmation_register.trigger_rule: ceil(T_completion * pool_processed_tokens / D_U_completion); completed-update crossings may overshoot in processed and completion tokens

prediction_rule: Primary errors use the stored planned-T predictions; report actual completion exposure and overshoot without replacing predictions. No confirmation fitting/selection.

bootstrap.unit: pool sample; six pools per student, three budgets kept together
bootstrap.pairing: same resampled pool indices across all methods, capabilities and both students
bootstrap.weighting: mean over three budgets within each pool, then equal mean over six pools
bootstrap.sign: baseline absolute error minus selected absolute error; positive favors selected
